issue_context.title: chore(deps): memory-fs is deprecated, migrate to memfs
issue_context.body: [memory-fs](https://github.com/webpack/memory-fs) is deprecated and not maintained anymore. It is advised to migrate to [memfs](https://github.com/streamich/memfs).
